# SocialPulse AI Sentiment and Topic Intelligence

SocialPulse is an analytical dashboard for social media sentiment, emotion, topic, and trend intelligence.
It analyzes text across English and Hinglish (code-mixed), handling negations, hashtags, slang, and emojis.

## Core Capabilities
- Sentiment Classification: Positive, Negative, Neutral with confidence scoring
- Emotion Classification: Happiness, Anger, Sadness, Frustration, Fear, Surprise, Neutral
- Topic Classification: Technology, Sports, Food, Travel, Education, Traffic, Entertainment, Shopping, Customer Service, Politics, Other
- Temporal Analysis: Sentiment over time, volume aggregation, spike anomaly detection
- Dataset Support: Bundled realistic sample data, validated CSV uploads, live stream simulation
